s: September 24, 2024 - Tanukikoji Shopping Arcade is one of Sapporo’s oldest shopping streets. Stretching over seven blocks, it offers everything from traditional crafts and souvenirs to modern-day fashion and electronics. This covered shopping street ensures you have a great shopping experience no matter the weather. If you’re a food lover, Nijo Market is the place for you. This local market sells fresh seafood, local produce, and various specialty items. It’s an excellent place to buy fresh crabs, sea urchins, and other seafood delicacies to take home, vacuum-sealed for your convenience.
